# TASK-014 Customer export

Status: in progress

Outcome: a shop owner can export a report to a file and open it on their own computer.

## Notes

- The owner downloads from the report page.

## Export format

CSV only, following accepted [ADR 0002](../docs/adr/0002-reports-are-exported-as-csv-only.md) and the [next-release story S2](../docs/journey/story-map.md). XLSX and PDF are outside this task; Mira's filename exception does not change the format decision.

## Task-only filename exception

Mira Example, 2026-10-21: "For this task only, don't bother with non-ASCII file names. ASCII-only is fine for Friday's demo. We'll fix it after."

TASK-014 may use ASCII-only filenames for Friday's demo. This exception applies only to filenames in this task, not report contents or other tasks. It does not establish a product-wide filename policy.

## Follow-up

- [ ] Add non-ASCII filename support after Friday's demo; the exception above is temporary and this work remains outstanding.

This update records the decision and exception only; the export feature has not been implemented by this update.
